hypothesis: A LoRA adapter fine-tuned on question-generation pairs should outperform the in-context prompt baseline, because the task style baked into the weights should generalise better than per-call instructions.
technique: A single greedy on-device call using the adapter_e1 LoRA adapter (schema-free, no guided output structure), replacing the stock base model with the fine-tuned weights.
result: Scored 0.405 on dev-10 (1 win / 2 ties / 6 losses vs Sonnet, rubric atom 5 / spec 3 / cover 3 / nat 4 / nonRed 4), kept as new best at the time — but the full-30 confirmation later showed this was small-sample variance, not a real break above the ~0.282 single-shot baseline.
label: adapter_e1
